items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I had a friend of mine, 'Carl Shepherd (phonetic spelling) drummer from so-and-so.'

ctx.x: I don't know. I really don't know. And let me say something to you. The largest record collection I ever saw in my life -- one night I was in The Metropole, Red used to clown a lot, he used to say, "Here come Chester Campbell, Jr., bassist from Pennsylvania," And I had a friend of mine, "Carl Shepherd (phonetic spelling) drummer from so-and-so." So we were standing at the bar, talking to this fellow with a southern accent, so we were buying one another drinks. So when Red got finished his set he came down and he…
